items.title: Did your favorite local Starbucks just close? These 36 SoCal locations are likely shuttered
items.summary: Starbucks said it would close 250 locations in North America as the chain battles increased competition. Thirty-six of those locations appear to be in Southern California.

items.title: Starbucks rival cafe chain has closed 130 locations
items.summary: People might still buy an indulgent coffee, but they’re cutting back elsewhere.

items.title: Starbucks Will Close 250 Stores. His $20,000 401(k) Loan Won’t Count Against Social Security’s Earnings Test, but It Could Make More of His Benefit Taxable
items.summary: When Starbucks closes his store, a 64-year-old barista's unpaid 401(k) loan could quietly pull thousands of dollars in Social Security benefits into taxable income, and a deadline most people miss determines whether any of it is avoidable.

items.title: Why Starbucks Is Shutting Hundreds of Cafes in the Middle of a Comeback
items.summary: Starbucks is closing hundreds of cafes while customer traffic is climbing, which raises an uncomfortable question about just how badly the chain misjudged its own expansion.

items.title: Better Dividend Bet: DRI or SBUX? The Cash Flow Numbers Reveal a Clear Winner
items.summary: Both Darden and Starbucks just got cheaper after steep selloffs, but one of them is quietly struggling to fund its own dividend from free cash flow while the other keeps raising payouts and buying back stock.

items.title: Starbucks Plans 250 Store Closures Across North America
items.summary: Starbucks store closures will eliminate 250 North American locations as the chain continues a $1B restructuring and major retrofit program.

items.title: Major coffee chain is closing 250 stores across North America
items.summary: A popular coffee chain is shutting down locations across North America, leaving some customers with fewer convenient options.
